integrity: The proof gives an explicit injection with an explicit missing principal downset for every strict order refinement. A standalone exhaustive replay checks every labeled poset through four points and every strict refinement pair there.
scientific_limitations: The theorem compares carrier cardinalities only; the injection used in the proof is not asserted to be an inquisitive-algebra homomorphism.
It does not classify all intermediate carrier sizes between the chain and antichain extrema.
The Dedekind-number endpoint is classical and is used only to identify the antichain extremum.
title: Strict order-refinement monotonicity for canonical finite inquisitive algebras
